options.label: Enable GestureSwitch
options.description: Off: the controller works exactly as in the game, as if the mod were not installed.

options.label: Input Method
options.description:
Gamepad: the mod works with controllers, and leaves the keyboard and mouse alone (no keyboard work at all).

Mouse and Keyboard: the chords and gestures also work on keyboard and mouse (the Keyboard & Mouse section at the bottom). A controller still works too.

options.label: Primary Weapons
options.description: Each way of attacking equips a primary form and attacks with it. Switching mid-combo keeps your place in the combo.

options.label: Enable Primary Weapons
options.description: Off: the Primary Attack button and the Primary Modifier work as in the game (finisher chords still attack). The settings below are kept for when it is back on.

options.label: Primary Style
options.description:
Dynamic: press, double-tap or hold the Primary Attack button to pick a primary form.

Modifier: hold the Primary Modifier and press the Primary Attack, Secondary Attack or Dash button to pick one; the Primary Attack button alone then attacks with no delay.

Mixed: normal attacks work as in Dynamic, and the Primary Modifier chords only set the primary, without a swing: for setting the weapon of your dash attacks.

options.label: Press
options.description: Primary Style Dynamic or Mixed: one press of the Primary Attack button.

options.label: Double-Tap
options.description: Primary Style Dynamic or Mixed: two quick presses of the Primary Attack button, for each swing. Mash it to keep swinging; mix it freely with presses and holds.

options.label: Hold
options.description: Primary Style Dynamic or Mixed: keep the Primary Attack button down.

options.label: Double-Tap Window (ms)
options.description:
Primary Style Dynamic or Mixed: after a short press, how long the mod waits for a second press before it counts as a single press.

Every single press waits this long, so keep it as short as you can double-tap reliably.

options.label: Hold Time (ms)
options.description: Primary Style Dynamic or Mixed: how long the Primary Attack button is held to count as a hold. (Finisher chords have their own Finisher Hold Time.)

options.label: Primary Modifier
options.description:
Primary Style Modifier or Mixed: the button held to pick a primary form.

On LB/L1 it still does what it does in the game until a chord fires; on LT/L2, RT/R2 or RB/R1 the game never sees it (they are the game's power buttons).

Give each kind of chord its own modifier.

options.label: Modifier + Primary
options.description: Primary Style Modifier or Mixed: hold the Primary Modifier and press the Primary Attack button.

options.label: Modifier + Secondary
options.description: Primary Style Modifier or Mixed: hold the Primary Modifier and press the Secondary Attack button.

options.label: Modifier + Dodge
options.description: Primary Style Modifier or Mixed: hold the Primary Modifier and press the Dash button.

options.label: Secondary Weapons
options.description:
Hold the Secondary Modifier and press the Primary Attack, Secondary Attack or Dash button to equip that secondary and attack with it.

Hold the button for the heavy attack.

options.label: Enable Secondary Weapons
options.description: Off: the Secondary Modifier works as in the game, and no secondary chords. The settings below are kept for when it is back on.

options.label: Secondary Modifier
options.description:
The button held to pick a secondary form.

On LB/L1 it still does what it does in the game until a chord fires; on LT/L2, RT/R2 or RB/R1 the game never sees it (they are the game's power buttons).

Give each kind of chord its own modifier.

options.label: Modifier + Primary
options.description: Hold the Secondary Modifier and press the Primary Attack button.

options.label: Modifier + Secondary
options.description: Hold the Secondary Modifier and press the Secondary Attack button.

options.label: Modifier + Dodge
options.description: Hold the Secondary Modifier and press the Dash button.

options.label: Combo finishers
options.description:
Hold the Finisher Modifier and press or hold the Primary Attack, Secondary Attack or Dash button to equip a finisher.

On a combo's third hit the finisher comes out at once; keep pressing the chord for its further hits.

options.label: Enable Combo Finishers
options.description: Off: the Finisher Modifier works as in the game, no finisher chords, and every combo ends with the finisher as in the game. The settings below are kept for when it is back on.

options.label: Finisher Style
options.description:
Dynamic: press or hold the chord button for one of two finishers per button (six in all).

Sets: the chord buttons always take a press, and play one of two sets of three finishers: set 1 is the Press finishers below, set 2 the Hold finishers. The Finisher Set Button swaps sets. Hold the chord button to charge a finisher that charges.

options.label: Finisher Set Button
options.description:
Finisher Style Sets: swaps between the two finisher sets.

It still does what it does in the game too.

options.label: Instant Finisher
options.description:
On: a finisher chord brings its finisher out straight away, wherever you are in the combo, without waiting for the third hit.

Experimental.

options.label: Finisher at End of Combo
options.description:
On: after the combo's last hit, the next attack is the finisher, as in the game.

Off: the combo starts over instead, and finishers only come from the finisher chords (turn on Instant Finisher).

options.label: Finisher Hold Time (ms)
options.description:
How long a finisher chord's button is held to count as a hold.

Keep it longer than a quick click or tap (about 100 ms on a mouse), or presses can count as holds.

options.label: Finisher Modifier
options.description:
The button held to pick a finisher.

On LB/L1 it still does what it does in the game until a chord fires; on LT/L2, RT/R2 or RB/R1 the game never sees it (they are the game's power buttons).

Give each kind of chord its own modifier.

options.label: Modifier + Primary (Press) (Hold)
options.description:
Hold the Finisher Modifier and press, or hold, the Primary Attack button.

Finisher Style Sets: Press is this button's finisher in set 1, Hold in set 2.

options.label: Modifier + Secondary (Press) (Hold)
options.description:
Hold the Finisher Modifier and press, or hold, the Secondary Attack button.

Finisher Style Sets: Press is this button's finisher in set 1, Hold in set 2.

options.label: Modifier + Dodge (Press) (Hold)
options.description:
Hold the Finisher Modifier and press, or hold, the Dash button.

Finisher Style Sets: Press is this button's finisher in set 1, Hold in set 2.

options.label: Combo
options.description:
Each weapon's own combo: how many times each of its three hits plays. One count runs through the combo, and every hit plays the attacking weapon's list at that count, so switching weapons carries the combo over.

At the end of a weapon's list the combo is complete (a primary's goes on to the finisher if Finisher at End of Combo is on); past its end, after switching from a weapon with a longer list, the combo starts over.

Experimental.

options.label: Enable Combo
options.description: Off: every weapon plays the game's own combo (each hit once), and primaries and secondaries are separate combos. The settings below are kept for when it is back on.

options.label: Primary and Secondary Share Combo
options.description:
On: primary and secondary weapons continue one combo. A secondary after two primary hits plays its third hit (by its own list), and the other way round.

Off: as in the game, they are separate combos and switching between them starts over.

Experimental.

options.label: Strike
options.description: How many times each of Strike's three combo hits plays. 0 skips that hit; 1, 1, 1 is the game's own combo.

options.label: Glaive
options.description: How many times each of Glaive's three combo hits plays. 0 skips that hit; 1, 1, 1 is the game's own combo.

options.label: Cleave
options.description: How many times each of Cleave's three combo hits plays. 0 skips that hit; 1, 1, 1 is the game's own combo.

options.label: Extend
options.description: How many times each of Extend's three combo hits plays. 0 skips that hit; 1, 1, 1 is the game's own combo.

options.label: Crush
options.description: How many times each of Crush's three combo hits plays. 0 skips that hit; 1, 1, 1 is the game's own combo.

options.label: Drill
options.description: How many times each of Drill's three combo hits plays. 0 skips that hit; 1, 1, 1 is the game's own combo.

options.label: Powers
options.description:
Hold the Power Modifier and press a button to use a power slot.

Letting go of the modifier lets go of the power; while a power is held, Jump and Dash work as usual.

options.label: Enable Powers
options.description: Off: the Power Modifier and the power buttons work as in the game, on controller and keyboard. The settings below are kept for when it is back on.

options.label: Power Modifier
options.description:
The button held to use a power.

On LB/L1 it still does what it does in the game until a chord fires; on LT/L2, RT/R2 or RB/R1 the game never sees it (they are the game's power buttons).

Give each kind of chord its own modifier.

On RT/R2 or RB/R1, LT/L2 takes over that button's power slot.

options.label: Power Style
options.description:
Dynamic: six power chords, on Primary Attack, Secondary Attack, Dash, Jump, RT/R2 and RB/R1.

Sets: power chords only on Primary Attack, Secondary Attack and Dash, with two sets of three powers. Set 1 is the powers set for Modifier + Primary, Secondary and Dash below; set 2 is the same buttons' powers on the other page (Power 1 and 4, 2 and 5, 3 and 6 swap). The Power Set Button swaps sets. Jump stays free while you hold the Power Modifier, and the Jump, RT/R2 and RB/R1 rows are not used.

options.label: Power Set Button
options.description:
Power Style Sets: swaps between the two power sets.

It still does what it does in the game too. The default, D-pad Right, is also the game's own button for swapping power sets, so the two stay together. If you change it here, remove the game's keybind for swapping power sets (in the game's keybind settings), or that button will keep swapping the game's set on its own.

options.label: Modifier + Primary
options.description:
Hold the Power Modifier and press the Primary Attack button.

Power Style Sets: this button's power in set 1; in set 2 the one at the same place on the other page (1 and 4, 2 and 5, 3 and 6).

options.label: Modifier + Secondary
options.description:
Hold the Power Modifier and press the Secondary Attack button.

Power Style Sets: this button's power in set 1; in set 2 the one at the same place on the other page (1 and 4, 2 and 5, 3 and 6).

options.label: Modifier + Dodge
options.description:
Hold the Power Modifier and press the Dash button.

Power Style Sets: this button's power in set 1; in set 2 the one at the same place on the other page (1 and 4, 2 and 5, 3 and 6).

options.label: Modifier + Jump
options.description:
Hold the Power Modifier and press the Jump button.

Not used in Power Style Sets.

options.label: Modifier + RT/R2
options.description:
Hold the Power Modifier and press RT/R2 (LT/L2 if RT/R2 is the Power Modifier).

Not used in Power Style Sets.

options.label: Modifier + RB/R1
options.description:
Hold the Power Modifier and press RB/R1 (LT/L2 if RB/R1 is the Power Modifier).

Not used in Power Style Sets.

options.label: Damage
options.description: How hard your weapon attacks hit, in percent of the game's own values: Damage (health taken off) and Falter (how fast enemies stagger). Powers are not changed.

options.label: Enable Damage
options.description: Off: every attack does the game's own damage and falter. The settings below are kept for when it is back on.

options.label: Damage Settings
options.description:
Everything: one Damage and Falter for every weapon.

By Type: one pair for primaries, one for secondaries, one for combo finishers.

By Weapon: a pair for each weapon.

Only the settings of the chosen kind are used.

options.label: Everything: Damage
options.description: Damage Settings Everything: the damage of every weapon attack, in percent of the game's.

options.label: Everything: Falter
options.description: Damage Settings Everything: the falter of every weapon attack, in percent of the game's.

options.label: Keyboard & Mouse (experimental)
options.description:
Input Method Mouse and Keyboard (at the top). The chords work on keyboard and mouse too: hold a modifier key and press the game's Primary Attack, Secondary Attack or the Third Key.

Primary attacks follow the Primary Style above.

A modifier key still does what it does in the game (Alt still starts and answers radio calls) until a chord fires; then the game sees it let go.

In development.

options.label: Third Key
options.description:
The third key of the chords, with the game's Primary and Secondary Attack keys (it takes the place of the controller's Dash button).

On its own it does what it does in the game.

options.label: Primary Modifier Key
options.description: Primary Style Modifier or Mixed: hold it and press one of the three keys above to pick a primary.

options.label: Secondary Modifier Key
options.description: Hold it and press one of the three keys above to pick a secondary and attack with it.

options.label: Finisher Modifier Key
options.description: Hold it and press, or hold, one of the three keys above to pick a finisher.

options.label: Finisher Set Key
options.description:
Finisher Style Sets: swaps between the two finisher sets.

It still does what it does in the game too, unless it is one of the game's power keys (then only the set swaps).

options.label: Power Style (Keyboard)
options.description:
Standard: the game's own six power keys, one for each power, as in the game.

Sets: hold the Power Modifier Key and press Primary Attack, Secondary Attack or the Third Key to use a power. Set 1 is the powers set for Modifier + Primary, Secondary and Dash in the Powers section; set 2 the same buttons' powers on the other page. The Power Set Key swaps sets. Letting go of the modifier lets go of the power. The game's own power keys must stay bound: the mod presses them.

options.label: Power Modifier Key
options.description:
Power Style (Keyboard) Sets: hold it and press Primary Attack, Secondary Attack or the Third Key to use a power.

The game never sees it (its default, E, is also one of the game's power keys).

options.label: Power Set Key
options.description:
Power Style (Keyboard) Sets: swaps between the two power sets.

It still does what it does in the game too, unless it is one of the game's power keys (then only the set swaps).
